blurb: Guests enjoy a two-hour private cruise on a quiet electric boat in Northport Harbor. Cruises include options for swimming, paddleboarding, and customizable add-ons like food and drinks. The boat accommodates up to 6 guests with a dedicated captain.
extraNote: Full refund or credit for cancellations made 7 days or more in advance · 30% non-refundable cancellation fee if cancelled within 7 days, credited toward future reservation within 12 months · Operator cancellation due to weather results in rescheduling · No-shows charged full price with no refund · Britannia Yachting Center, 81 Fort Salonga Road, Northport, NY 11768; meet captain on the Deck of Britannia
